author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC285.11

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

propagation. The yeast ortholog of dsc5 is UBX3 (
GO:0032933 | SREBP signaling pathway)
SGD do not list  UBX2 and UBX3 as paralogs, and they appear to be in different pathways, so  the propagation is safer to remove (they do have the same domain organization though)


* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue: GO:0036503	 ERAD pathway IBA with PTN000595050 , Q96CS3 , S000004475	GO_REF:0000033

author: marcfeuermann
body: With about 80 duplication events within this family, it is a challenge to create a function evolutionary model. I've reviewed the PAINTing, reducing the annotations to small nodes.
